title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - EntityCatalog
description: The root entity for entity catalog management. An entity catalog can be defined as a collection of entity catalog items and arranging them in a particular manner based on the need. In comparison to Product, Service and Resource catalogs, the entity catalog is intended for the purpose of providing any SID entity to consumers via a catalog, with its specification and policy providing governance over its content. Even Entity catalog may have an overlap with Product, Service or Resource catalog, it does not replace them. It is primarily intended to address those SID entities which may not be addressed by any of Product, Service or Resource catalog. An entity catalog comprises of a list of RootEntities made available through EntityCatalogItems. This API addresses only RootEntity extended items as EntitySpecification. An entity catalog typically includes name, description and time period that it is valid for. (TM Forum TMF662 Entity Catalog Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition EntityCatalog; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:EntityCatalog:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EntityCatalog'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:EntityCatalog:<tmfId>. unique identifier

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status

category.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/category'. The categories used in this catalog. In TMF this is an array of EntityCategoryRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced EntityCategory entities (urn:ngsi-ld:EntityCategory:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/relatedParty'. The parties who are involved or have an interest in this catalog

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/validFor'. The period for which the catalog is valid

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/EntityCatalog/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'EntityCatalog' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

RelatedParty.description: Related Entity reference. A related party defines party or party role linked to a specific entity.

role.description: Role played by the related party

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
